column1: # Annex H, read against docs/annex-h-glossary.html on 2026-09-24.

column3: The annex is titled "Annex H (informative) Glossary" and §1.5 lists it as "H. (informative) Glossary — This annex describes various terms used in this document." Its one "shall" ("Nets declared as ground shall be bound to the reference node", under "reference node") restates §1.3.1.1/§3.6.4, where the normative rule and its fixtures live (ch01_intro/02_reference_ground.va, 24_two_ground_nets.va). CLAUSE-AUDIT §5.6 lists annex_h_glossary as non-normative.
